methods.title: Sources
methods.intro: How each number is computed, checked and credited.
methods.fao56.title: FAO-56 reference and crop water use
methods.fao56.assumption0: Daily weather from NASA POWER: temperature, humidity, wind, solar radiation.
methods.fao56.assumption1: Soil heat flux G is zero at a daily step.
methods.fao56.assumption2: Kc follows the four FAO-56 growth stages; fallow uses soil evaporation.
methods.waterBalance.title: Water balance
methods.waterBalance.assumption0: Runoff uses a simplified curve-number method by soil group and cover.
methods.waterBalance.assumption1: Water above field capacity drains away.
methods.waterBalance.assumption2: Root depth grows with crop stage.
methods.waterBalance.assumption3: Irrigation is not modeled or prescribed.
methods.scoring.title: Scoring and resilience
methods.scoring.assumption0: Eight criteria, each scaled 0–1: climate fit, water, nitrogen, organic matter, erosion, bare soil, pests, forage or income.
methods.scoring.assumption1: Weights come from your priority sliders.
methods.scoring.assumption2: Rankings are relative, not yield forecasts.
methods.monteCarlo.title: Monte Carlo uncertainty
methods.monteCarlo.assumption0: The same seed always gives the same bands.
methods.monteCarlo.assumption1: Bands show how much a ranking depends on uncertain inputs.
methods.deltaChange.title: 2050 delta-change
methods.deltaChange.assumption0: Monthly factors compare 2041–2060 with 1995–2014 in NASA NEX-GDDP models, per emissions scenario.
methods.deltaChange.assumption1: Factors shift the observed daily record into plausible 2050 seasons.
methods.deltaChange.assumption2: The median model sets the result; the lowest and highest models set the range.
methods.deltaChange.assumption3: Scenarios, not forecasts: each season keeps its observed weather pattern.
methods.fieldMemory.title: Field Memory
methods.fieldMemory.assumption0: Greenness from HLS (30 m) where available, otherwise MODIS (250 m).
methods.fieldMemory.assumption1: Labels come from the timing and size of the peak; your confirmation overrides them.
methods.fieldMemory.assumption2: Satellite estimates differ from ground truth; soil tests and field notes win.
